title: Complete nonhuman requirements owner: all rounds, self-corrections and selected-consumer boundary
head: b6678ea9ba4a7cf0313ce83e0c0fc6b0e5c26d5b

reviews.classification: Full chronology and requirements router; later corrections and current authority qualify opening shorthand
reviews.disposition:
F1. Complete read covers all690 input lines, F1–F9/B1–B11/E1–E15, start-kind K table, M1–M11, N1–N46, C1–C16, NR1–NR12, MM1–MM7, SB1–SB16, OT1–OT25, CV1–CV12, OA1–OA6, IM1–IM7, local CW1–CW8/illustrative NA1–NA8, all eleven dated rounds, later K1–K8 corrections and the Oct18 selection boundary. Those rounds are chronological research/dispatch history, not current workers or permission to spawn, commit or push. The wave's26 runs/23 completions/three stopped returns describe historical execution, not full primary-book or current runtime coverage. Qualify overlapping K/CW/NA codes by owner and heading.

F2. The owner's own later K2/K3/K5/K6/K7 corrections already supersede important opening shorthand: combat arrays exist; heirs do not inherently construct a human; intentional form admission can remain; knowledge belongs to its actual knower rather than an abstract controller; affection can affect an offer without lending the partner's hands; later abstraction rows replace the initial illustrative NA list. M1's sword receiving wielder XP and good offline activity are not universal grants or a general offline-engine requirement. Actual body-supported work, mental/local practice and scoped beneficiary receipts supply useful idle play. N25/IM3 missing-test claims retain their dated search scope rather than demanding recreation of already covered routes.

F3. The Oct18 boundary already prevents the F/B/E census and Slice1 framework from becoming a universal prerequisite. Select one actual body/faculty/action with its means, custody/control/clock consumer; an explicit compatibility/drop/reset choice may be valid, while retained selected state needs its claimed round-trip. No blanket schema migration, full biology taxonomy, registry, ontology, all-N32 fixtures, second consumer or autonomous society is required merely by a category name. AD51 qualifies the older second-consumer abstraction threshold: design a shared seam from known mechanisms and prove claimed reuse with a different world. Current campaign/ownership overrides the old hound/HP/D&D ranking; old reservations and1366-primary/milestone statements are historical.

F4. Keep useful distinctions from the expanded rounds: ordinary nourishment versus finite action/source support; title/holder/controller versus willingness; native mind versus human memory; witnessed event versus received report; copied record versus a source-defined actual continuing person; body age versus subjective duration/world calendar; passage versus habitat/useful arrival; body stage versus institutional access. A genuinely restorative copy, true shared mind, perfect faculty or powerful source can join outcomes when its mechanism supports it under AD38. N39 is a warning against assuming restoration from record availability, not a ban on actual source restoration. N16/N18/N30/IM7 do not make a mission vessel a guaranteed safe save sandbox or universal Paradise body-issuance law.

F5. MM/NR/SB ideas are conditional palettes: warmth/comfort can be truthful text without new bonuses or tax; offspring/maker relation does not universally create care duties or control; grief does not force a meter, revenge or mandatory price on bond loss. An observed signal can be misread without omniscient motive disclosure. A successful actual soul/kin/disguise-reading power may reveal its supported result, but the early CV shorthand does not permit hidden-origin existence leaks or whole mind-reading by label. Body-appropriate UI remains accessible independently of fictional senses, with actual observer-qualified labels and stable event subjects. Comic mantle/identity and crossover examples are source-qualified proposals, not a compulsory world-wide event affecting every place or a fixed visual skin.

F6. This full owner review incorporates B244's concrete same-revision hound-definition conflict, four example-pack header collision and blade sample-item binding issue, and B241's unresolved bird appointment accounting. They live in the actual authoring/start owners; this requirements router does not duplicate a new schema or runtime queue. Under AD32 all unchanged proposals remain proposals; AD36/AD43 set affected checks and AD42 keeps human review optional. Current desktop prose-first/optional-art and ACR activity-compression owners apply. No new code, primary source, schema migration, natural admission, native behavior, save/browser, install or commit proof follows.
reviews.evidence: Entire690-line input delivered in ranges1–150,151–300,301–455,456–610,611–690. Linked source bodies/current runtime are not freshly reverified.
reviews.reopen: Selected actual body/action or changed accepted direction; use current source and authoring/start-specific unresolved definition, instance or scheduling contracts. Do not reopen historical lanes or require the complete framework.
